svg.title: Tech stack on three conveyor belts
svg.desc: Three conveyor belts carry all 73 tools of the toolbox. Languages and front-end: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TanStack Query, Vite, Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, Zustand, Recharts, React Router, Bootstrap, Vue Router, Lucide, React Icons, next-intl, next-themes, jsPDF. Back-end, data and infra: Node.js, Express, Hono, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, Auth.js, Zod, Google Identity, aws4fetch, Resend, JWT, bcrypt, Supabase Auth, Midtrans, API.co.id, React Email, Tesseract.js, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Vercel, Cloudflare R2, Hostinger, Netlify. Machine learning and tooling: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Git, Claude Code, Vitest, GitHub Actions, Keras, pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, Jupyter, Hugging Face, NLTK, Sastrawi, GitHub, Playwright, ESLint, Biome, Postman, Figma, Codex.
